title: Managed memory, lifetime and call pinning
summary: ForeignBuffer may own runtime memory or borrow provider memory with release callback. Managed structs may retain pointer-field child resources; invocation pins the transitive reachable graph and rejects cycles/stale closure.
invariants: Readonly imported buffers reject out/inout use.
Closing a managed child before a later parent invocation must fail closed rather than dereference stale storage.
Embedded NUL bytes and exact byte slices are preserved.
